title: Cognyte Secures ~$10 Million Contract with Long-Standing APAC National Security Customer
summary: The contract reflects the continued expansion of Cognyte’s work with existing customers as their intelligence environments evolve.
body_markdown:
**HERZLIYA, Israel, September 15, 2026** –[Cognyte Software Ltd](https://www.cognyte.com/) . (NASDAQ: CGNT) (“Cognyte”), a global leader in AI-powered investigative analytics solutions, today announced that a long-standing national security customer in the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region has selected Cognyte for a new contract valued at approximately $10 million. The contract reflects the continued expansion of Cognyte’s work with existing customers as their intelligence environments evolve, data volumes grow and new operational challenges emerge. The newly deployed capabilities are designed to help the customer scale secure intelligence operations, strengthen mission readiness and support increasingly demanding national security requirements.


As national security environments become more complex, agencies need intelligence capabilities that keep data, infrastructure and operations under their own control while enabling faster action. Cognyte’s solutions transform fragmented information into organized, connected and intelligence-ready insight inside the agency’s environment, helping analysts accelerate investigations, make stronger operational decisions and enhance public safety.


“Today’s national security missions demand intelligence capabilities that are secure, controlled and built for speed,” said Elad Sharon, CEO of Cognyte. “This contract reflects the continued trust of a long-standing customer and the broader demand for Cognyte’s enhanced capabilities. By turning complex data into actionable intelligence, we help our customers make more confident decisions and act faster to protect communities and safeguard national security.”


**About Cognyte**


Cognyte is a global leader in AI-powered investigative analytics solutions that empower customers with Actionable Intelligence for a Safer World®. Cognyte’s solutions enable law enforcement, national security and military intelligence agencies, as well as other organizations, to navigate an increasingly complex threat landscape. With offerings that leverage advanced technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI) and analytics, Cognyte helps customers make sense of growing volumes of fragmented multi-source data to help identify, assess, and mitigate risks across dynamic environments, supporting informed, mission-critical investigations and operations. Hundreds of customers worldwide rely on Cognyte’s intelligence platform to uncover insights and reveal what matters, enabling confident decision-making in high-stakes environments. Learn more at **[www.cognyte.com](https://www.cognyte.com/) .**
